title: Recipe service codegen must discover kernel recipe element declarations
body: Advancing VIXEN to kernel 597757236569835a7b40ed01ec04c06e286af723 made SampleSurface declare SurfacePoint, but the normal VIXEN recipe-services command did not include the kernel RecipeElementKinds.cs source. I had to add that source manually to VIXEN/codegen/CMakeLists.txt and regenerate. Suggested consolidation: derive all recipe element declaration inputs from the pinned kernel provider when constructing the recipe plan.

title: Recipe SIMD codegen must emit evaluator dispatch when configured
body: The VIXEN CMake recipe SIMD command had an output variable for SdfRecipeEvalDispatch.g.inc but omitted the corresponding --out-eval-dispatch argument, leaving the stale evaluator face after the d9 opcode advance. I had to wire the flag manually before regeneration. Suggested consolidation: make configured recipe codegen outputs and CLI arguments a checked one-to-one graph.

title: Recipe graph emitter must initialize appended socket metadata
body: The d9 generated SdfGraphInputSocket gained sourceLayerId and sourcePort, while the emitter still emitted old aggregate initializers. VIXEN then required a compiler diagnostic suppression around the generated SdfOpCodes include to keep the consumer build warning-clean. Suggested consolidation: generated aggregate initializers must initialize every emitted field, or emit designated/value-initialized records when schema fields are appended.
